description: List every section in one TITLE of the Louisiana Revised Statutes with its heading and doc_id — Title 14 Criminal Law, Title 32 Motor Vehicles, Title 47 Revenue and Taxation, Title 9 Civil Code Ancillaries — optionally filtered by a word in the heading, so an agent can find the right section when a keyword search is too broad ("every section of Title 14 with 'homicide' in its heading"). Repealed sections are flagged. Keyless; sourced live from the Louisiana State Legislature's table of contents.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring to match in the section heading or citation, e.g. "homicide".

limit.description: Max sections to return, default 50, max 200.

offset.description: Skip this many matching sections, default 0 — for paging through a large title.

title.description: Revised Statutes title number, e.g. "14" (Criminal Law), "32" (Motor Vehicles), "47" (Revenue and Taxation).

name: louisiana_title_contents
title: Louisiana Title Contents
